title: Robust compact-field plane-sweep placement (float64 successor)
question: Does coarse-to-fine source-excluded robust compact-field agreement improve held-out compact-field reconstruction relative to the same fixed source rays placed at their bounded midpoint or scored by all-view consensus?
hypothesis: With identical deterministic source anchors, bounds, float64 field computation, field refit, topology, and evaluation samples, robust source-excluded sweep reduces final held-out compact RGB MSE by at least 5% relative to bounded midpoint and wins at least two of three paired seeds on both outcome-exposed scenes, while retaining at least 95% supported tracks and preserving source projection.
claim_boundary: Development and replication evidence about three named CPU compact-field placement arms on outcome-exposed frames 00008 and 00009. This repaired successor changes only the shared compute precision and failure observability after the predecessor failed before measurement. It cannot establish RGB image quality, physical surface accuracy, GPU behavior, speed, cross-dataset generalization, topology utility, or a production-default change.

stages.label: Fixed-anchor placement
stages.purpose: Select one deterministic balanced top-mass source-ray set per seed and place it by bounded midpoint, all-view consensus sweep, or source-excluded robust sweep under shared float64 CPU computation.

stages.label: Matched field refit
stages.purpose: Run identical continuous field-fiber refit with topology disabled so later metrics isolate placement and its interaction with the same optimizer.

stages.label: Held-out compact evaluation
stages.purpose: Evaluate immutable held-out compact teachers only after each arm finishes and preserve per-view, seed, scene, and source-projection diagnostics.

comparators.label: Bounded midpoint
comparators.purpose: No-sweep lower control using the exact same source rays, AABB intervals, covariance construction, count, compute dtype, and refit.

comparators.label: All-view consensus sweep
comparators.purpose: Controls source-view exclusion and robust trimming while retaining the same coarse-to-fine depth grid, fixed anchors, compute dtype, and refit.

primary_metrics.label: Placement held-out compact RGB MSE
primary_metrics.aggregation: sample-weighted held-out views, paired by scene and seed; the root summary is the robust-arm geometric mean, with every arm cell and the robust-to-midpoint geometric mean ratio retained

primary_metrics.label: Final held-out compact RGB MSE
primary_metrics.aggregation: sample-weighted held-out views, paired by scene and seed; robust sweep must win at least two of three seeds on each scene

primary_metrics.label: Final held-out compact density MSE
primary_metrics.aggregation: sample-weighted held-out views, paired by scene and seed

primary_metrics.label: Supported track fraction
primary_metrics.aggregation: minimum over robust-sweep scene and seed cells; frozen guardrail at 0.95

primary_metrics.label: Source projection maximum error
primary_metrics.aggregation: maximum over every arm, scene, and seed; structural guardrail at 0.0002 pixels

primary_metrics.label: CPU wall time
primary_metrics.aggregation: descriptive per-arm and per-scene medians over three measured seeds; the root summary is the median of all measured cells and supports no performance claim

resource_protocol.scope: fresh single-thread CPU process per scene, seed, and arm from compact-manifest open through final field validation and atomic artifact save; arm order is counterbalanced across measured seeds
resource_protocol.aggregation: one discarded warmup per scene and arm, followed by three paired measured seeds; retain every raw scene, seed, arm, end-to-end time, worker time, output size, and ru_maxrss; timings are descriptive only
